title_zh: 金川集团股份有限公司原党委副书记、总经理李尚勇接受审查调查
title_en: Li Shangyong, Former GM of Jinchuan Group, Under Investigation
summary_zh: 金川集团股份有限公司原党委副书记、总经理李尚勇涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受甘肃省纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: Li Shangyong, former Deputy Secretary of the Party Committee and General Manager of Jinchuan Group, is under investigation by the Gansu Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervisory Commission for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.
